decision: Earlier four narrow source blockers are addressed by patches05/06/07. Release still requires target build, raw/FAT qualification, emulator gates and authorized hardware qualification for new kernel.

checks.finding: Both loops check wide position before each narrowed block index. At or above64MiB rejected without wrapped request; crossing transfers preserve completed prefix. Generic16-bit block interface remains unchanged.

Length bound precedes multiplication; metadata sums representable in32 bits, then16-bit bound before assignment. Sector-size mismatch, zero fields, illegal cluster powers, metadata>=total, zero cluster count, nonmirrored FAT32, version, fixed FAT32 root entries and root outside data/FAT bounds refused. Duplicate static corrected.
checks.qualification: 91 extracted actual-function/gate cases pass ASan/UBSan. Packed BPB layout asserts pass. Host arithmetic adapts unsigned long to uint32_t; host int remains32 so actual16-bit target build/emulator are still required.

checks.finding: FAT32 reads mask low28 before EOF interpretation. Each copy updates low28 while preserving its own original high nibble; pointer initialized from that copy before use. FAT12/16 branches unchanged.

mount_rejection_evidence: Exact mapped-buffer validation/release/NULL fragment extracted from msdos_read_super and executed for all91 inputs. Guard sits before first geometry-field assignment and before later msdos_prepare_rw; no mark_buffer_dirty/WRITE/FSInfo call in prefix. This establishes the direct malformed-geometry rejection path, not full kernel mount behavior or absence of unrelated cache writeback.
retained_limits: Inherited buffered write/sync error-reporting limitation remains; no durable-success claim.
Header-only MODE SENSE remains assumed write-through, not proof of power-loss durability.
No partition, LFN, hotplug, multiple-device, generic block widening or counter subsystem added.
